blocks.text: Logical inference maloom maloomat se naye facts nikalne ka amal hai. Yeh reasoning ka aisa tareeqa hai jo logic ke qaidon par chalta hai. Maslan agar hum jante hain “Tamam insaan faani hain (sab ko maut aani hai)” aur “Socrates insaan hai,” to hum nateeja nikal sakte hain ke “Socrates faani hai.” Agar premises (shuru ki di hui baatein) sach hon to logical inference ka nateeja bhi sach hota hai. Yeh maths, computer science aur artificial intelligence mein istemal hota hai. Inference saboot (evidence) ki bunyad par faisle karne mein madad deta hai aur logic aur reasoning ka bunyadi concept hai.

items: Inference: maloom facts (premises) se logic ke qaidon par naya fact nikalna.
Socrates: tamam insaan faani, Socrates insaan, is liye Socrates faani.
